{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    {
      "id": "CHAR_ARTIE",
      "name": "Artie",
      "role": "Protagonist",
      "description": "A cynical IT worker turned reality-glitching exploiter."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_SYSTEM",
      "name": "The System",
      "role": "Antagonist",
      "description": "The automated governing logic of the world, prone to errors."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_CAPTAIN",
      "name": "Guard Captain",
      "role": "Local Antagonist",
      "description": "A scripted enforcer of local laws, vulnerable to physics bugs."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_SENTINEL",
      "name": "System Sentinel",
      "role": "Enforcer",
      "description": "A high-level anti-virus entity deployed to delete anomalies."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_ADMIN",
      "name": "Regional Administrator",
      "role": "Zone Boss",
      "description": "A high-tier logic entity responsible for zone stability."
    }
  ],
  "threads": [
    {
      "id": "TH_GLITCH",
      "title": "Exploiting the System",
      "description": "Artie's use of bugs and oversights to gain power."
    },
    {
      "id": "TH_SURVIVAL",
      "title": "Staying Un-Deleted",
      "description": "The constant threat of the System identifying and removing Artie."
    },
    {
      "id": "TH_LEGACY",
      "title": "The Legacy Code",
      "description": "The search for ancient, un-patched code to stabilize Artie's existence."
    }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Final Five O'Clock",
          "intent": "Establish Artie's mundane life and the catastrophic accident that triggers the transition.",
          "end_condition": "Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie is trapped in the server room during a structural failure.",
              "location_start_label": "Server Room",
              "location_end_label": "Server Room",
              "location_start": "A cramped, humming server room at the end of a shift.",
              "location_end": "The same room, now shaking violently from an earthquake.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie sighs as he clocks out, the fluorescent lights flickering overhead.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["clocking out", "humming servers", "flickering lights"],
              "transition_out_text": "The ceiling groans, dropping dust onto the server racks.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["groaning ceiling", "falling dust", "unstable racks"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie's physical body is destroyed, and his consciousness begins a corrupted upload.",
              "location_start_label": "Server Room",
              "location_end_label": "Digital Void",
              "location_start": "The collapsing server room.",
              "location_end": "A swirling tunnel of binary data.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The main rack topples, pinning Artie as the world dissolves into sparking wires.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["toppling rack", "sparking wires", "white light"],
              "transition_out_text": "Consciousness fragments into a million lines of code.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["fragmenting mind", "binary rain", "ascending data"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Buffer Overflow",
          "intent": "Depict the character creation suite glitching as Artie's consciousness attempts to load.",
          "end_condition": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie accesses the character creation menu in a glitched state.",
              "location_start_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_end_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_start": "A sterile, white void with floating UI panels.",
              "location_end": "The UI panels begin to flicker and duplicate.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie blinks as the binary rain coalesces into a sterile white room.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["white void", "floating panels", "glitching text"],
              "transition_out_text": "He reaches out to touch a floating 'Luck' stat bar.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["luck stat", "floating bar", "interactive UI"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers he can subtract stats below zero to cause an overflow.",
              "location_start_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_end_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_start": "The flickering creation menu.",
              "location_end": "The menu begins to display negative values.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_in_text": "The 'Luck' bar resists his touch, but the 'Charisma' bar slides into the negatives.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["negative charisma", "sliding bars", "system error"],
              "transition_out_text": "The values start to spin rapidly, unable to find a floor.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["spinning numbers", "no floor", "logic break"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop that maximizes his stats.",
              "location_start_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_end_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_start": "The spinning stat menu.",
              "location_end": "A frozen, glowing UI screen showing 'NaN'.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie clicks the 'Confirm' button as the Luck stat hits a negative integer limit.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["integer limit", "confirm button", "recursive loop"],
              "transition_out_text": "The System freezes, a low hum vibrating through the void.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["system freeze", "low hum", "frozen void"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Spawn Point Error",
          "intent": "Artie finalizes his 'corrupted' build and enters the game world.",
          "end_condition": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "The stat sheet stabilizes with impossible, high-variance numbers.",
              "location_start_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_end_label": "Creation Void",
              "location_start": "The frozen UI screen.",
              "location_end": "A finalized, purple-tinted character sheet.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "The 'NaN' values flicker once more before settling into impossible numbers.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["impossible numbers", "purple tint", "finalized sheet"],
              "transition_out_text": "A 'Spawn' portal opens beneath Artie's feet.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["spawn portal", "opening floor", "descending"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie experiences the transition into the game world as a series of visual glitches.",
              "location_start_label": "Transition Tunnel",
              "location_end_label": "Transition Tunnel",
              "location_start": "A tunnel of unrendered textures and purple light.",
              "location_end": "The tunnel begins to resolve into a stone plaza.",
              "handoff_mode": "montage",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie falls through a sky of missing textures and placeholder cubes.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["missing textures", "placeholder cubes", "falling"],
              "transition_out_text": "The smell of fresh hay and stone dust hits him suddenly.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["smell of hay", "stone dust", "resolving world"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a corrupted stat sheet.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plaza",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plaza",
              "location_start": "The central spawn pad of the tutorial village.",
              "location_end": "Artie standing on the pad, surrounded by confused NPCs.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie lands with a heavy thud on the stone spawn pad.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["heavy thud", "spawn pad", "village center"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie steps off the spawn pad, his UI glowing a dangerous, neon purple.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["neon purple", "stepping off", "dangerous glow"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:1"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Quest Log Exploits",
          "intent": "Artie identifies the first major flaw in the tutorial's quest-completion logic.",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts a simple gathering quest from a tutorial NPC.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plaza",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plaza",
              "location_start": "The village center.",
              "location_end": "Artie talking to a villager named Barnaby.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie approaches the first NPC he sees, a bored-looking villager with a quest marker.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["quest marker", "villager", "approaching"],
              "transition_out_text": "He accepts the quest to gather five 'Sun-Herbs' from the fields.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sun-herbs", "gathering quest", "accepting"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that turning in the quest doesn't remove the herbs from his inventory.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "A field of glowing yellow herbs.",
              "location_end": "Artie standing by a collection basket.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The herbs are easy enough to find, their yellow petals glowing in the sun.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["yellow petals", "glowing herbs", "collecting"],
              "transition_out_text": "When he places them in the basket, the quest completes, but the herbs remain in his pack.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["collection basket", "quest complete", "items remain"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the quest as infinitely repeatable due to a logic error.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "Beside the collection basket.",
              "location_end": "Artie grinning as he realizes the exploit.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_in_text": "He looks from his inventory to the basket and back again.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["inventory check", "basket check", "realization"],
              "transition_out_text": "The quest marker over the basket resets instantly.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["marker reset", "instant reset", "exploit found"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Compounding Interest",
          "intent": "Artie grinds the exploit to stack illegal reward multipliers.",
          "end_condition": "Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie begins rapid-fire completion of the quest.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "Beside the collection basket.",
              "location_end": "Artie moving in a blur of motion.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie begins to spam the 'Interact' button with mechanical precision.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["spamming interact", "mechanical precision", "rapid fire"],
              "transition_out_text": "The XP notifications start to stack on top of each other.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["XP notifications", "stacking alerts", "grinding"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie triggers a hidden achievement for 'Speedy Herbivore'.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "The field, now littered with UI popups.",
              "location_end": "A golden achievement banner appears.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_in_text": "A sudden chime rings out, louder than the others.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["loud chime", "achievement pop", "golden banner"],
              "transition_out_text": "The banner grants a small multiplier to all future tutorial rewards.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["multiplier grant", "reward boost", "achievement effect"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "The multiplier begins to stack exponentially with each completion.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "The field.",
              "location_end": "The multiplier count in the corner of the UI hitting x100.",
              "handoff_mode": "montage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie realizes the multiplier itself is being applied to the achievement's trigger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["exponential growth", "multiplier stack", "logic flaw"],
              "transition_out_text": "The numbers in the corner of his eye start to blur into a single, massive digit.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blurring numbers", "massive digit", "scaling power"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie hits the x1000 multiplier limit.",
              "location_start_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Herb Fields",
              "location_start": "The field.",
              "location_end": "The UI screen flashing red as the multiplier caps.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_in_text": "With one final, frantic click, the multiplier hits the three-zero mark.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["final click", "x1000", "red flash"],
              "transition_out_text": "The System groans, a warning message flickering briefly before vanishing.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["system groan", "warning message", "vanishing alert"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Golden Handshake",
          "intent": "Artie collects the massive payout and prepares to leave the starting zone.",
          "end_condition": "Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie claims his rewards, which overflow into legendary-tier items.",
              "location_start_label": "Reward Altar",
              "location_end_label": "Reward Altar",
              "location_start": "A stone altar at the edge of the village.",
              "location_end": "The altar buried under a pile of glowing loot.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks to the Reward Altar to cash in his stacked achievements.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["reward altar", "cashing in", "stacked rewards"],
              "transition_out_text": "The altar erupts in a fountain of gold and purple light.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["loot fountain", "purple light", "legendary drop"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie equips a legendary item that bypasses level requirements.",
              "location_start_label": "Reward Altar",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Exit Gate",
              "location_start": "Beside the loot pile.",
              "location_end": "The massive stone gates of the tutorial zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_in_text": "Among the pile, a single blade hums with a frequency that makes Artie's teeth ache.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["humming blade", "teeth ache", "equipping"],
              "transition_out_text": "He heads for the exit, the guards looking at him with programmed confusion.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["tutorial exit", "confused guards", "heading out"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie exits the tutorial zone with legendary gear.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Exit Gate",
              "location_end_label": "World Map - Crossroads",
              "location_start": "The gates.",
              "location_end": "The open road beyond the tutorial.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "transition_in_text": "The gates swing open, unable to find a reason to keep a 'Level 1' with such high stats.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["opening gates", "level check", "passing through"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie walks through the tutorial exit, the legendary sword on his back humming with illegal power.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["illegal power", "humming sword", "walking away"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.",
              "hands_off_to": "3:1"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Stop Right There",
          "intent": "The local authorities attempt to process Artie's anomalous presence.",
          "end_condition": "Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie arrives at the first major city and is immediately flagged.",
              "location_start_label": "World Map - Crossroads",
              "location_end_label": "Town Entrance",
              "location_start": "The open road.",
              "location_end": "The fortified gates of Oakhaven.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:10",
              "transition_in_text": "The lush green of the tutorial fades into the dusty, cobblestone roads of the main world.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cobblestone roads", "main world", "approaching city"],
              "transition_out_text": "As he nears the gate, a red light pulses from the guard's scanner.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["gate guards", "red light", "scanner pulse"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie is detained by guards who cannot reconcile his level with his gear.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Guard Barracks",
              "location_start": "The city gate.",
              "location_end": "A cold, stone holding cell.",
              "handoff_mode": "escorted_transfer",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The guards surround him, spears leveled at his chest.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["surrounding guards", "leveled spears", "arrest"],
              "transition_out_text": "They march him toward the barracks, whispering about his 'illegal' sword.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["marching", "barracks", "whispering guards"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie is confronted by the Guard Captain in an interrogation room.",
              "location_start_label": "Guard Barracks",
              "location_end_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_start": "The barracks hallway.",
              "location_end": "A dim room with a single table and two chairs.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
              "transition_in_text": "The heavy iron door of the interrogation room swings open.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["iron door", "interrogation", "entering"],
              "transition_out_text": "The Captain sits down, his eyes glowing with scripted authority.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["captain", "glowing eyes", "scripted authority"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.",
              "hands_off_to": "3:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Collision Detection",
          "intent": "Artie uses tutorial-tier items to break the local physics engine.",
          "end_condition": "Artie creates a physics-based feedback loop using three stackable boxes.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies physics-enabled objects in the room.",
              "location_start_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_end_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_start": "The interrogation room.",
              "location_end": "Artie looking at a stack of wooden crates in the corner.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie ignores the Captain's questions, his eyes fixed on the crates in the corner.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["ignoring questions", "wooden crates", "corner"],
              "transition_out_text": "He notices they lack the 'static' flag in his glitched UI.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["static flag", "glitched UI", "physics check"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "build",
              "outcome": "Artie begins stacking the boxes in a specific, unstable configuration.",
              "location_start_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_end_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_start": "The interrogation room.",
              "location_end": "Artie standing on the table, stacking boxes.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:4",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie stands up, knocking his chair over, and moves for the crates.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["knocking chair", "moving", "crates"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stacks three of them, one balanced precariously on its corner.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stacking", "precarious balance", "corner"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie triggers a physics feedback loop.",
              "location_start_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_end_label": "Interrogation Room",
              "location_start": "The interrogation room.",
              "location_end": "The boxes vibrating and emitting a high-pitched whine.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:5",
              "transition_in_text": "He gives the middle box a slight nudge with his foot.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["nudge", "vibrating boxes", "high-pitched whine"],
              "transition_out_text": "The collision boxes begin to overlap, generating infinite force.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["overlapping boxes", "infinite force", "feedback loop"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie creates a physics-based feedback loop using three stackable boxes.",
              "hands_off_to": "3:7"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Sky-High Captain",
          "intent": "The confrontation concludes with a spectacular system failure.",
          "end_condition": "The Guard Captain is launched into the stratosphere by a collision bug.",
          "scenes": [
            {
